core_categories: Medical Devices; Maternal and Child Healthcare; Home-Use Diagnostic Tools; Therapy and Rehabilitation Devices; OEM/ODM/JDM Services
specialty_focus: Shenzhen Jumper Medical Equipment is a manufacturer of intelligent medical devices, specializing in maternal and child healthcare solutions, home-use diagnostic tools, and clinical obstetric information systems. It designs, manufactures, and sells products such as fetal dopplers, fetal monitors, pulse oximeters, infrared thermometers, blood pressure monitors, and therapy devices. The company also provides OEM/ODM/JDM custom manufacturing services for global medical device brands.
